title: Desktop Survivors 98
description:
SURVIVE, EXPLORE, REPEATSurvive against waves of enemies in quick, intense rounds as you explore the randomly generated dungeons. Your cursor becomes the hero, battling against foes in a bullet hell frenzy that tests your reflexes, precision, and decision-making.

PLAY ON YOUR DESKTOPDesktop Survivors 98 doesn’t play in a window — it plays over your desktop. Enemies, upgrades, and chaos unfold across your real screen.

Whether you’re looking for a quick break or an extended challenge, Desktop Survivors 98 fits perfectly into your routine. With its fast-paced rounds and the ability to toggle the game at any moment, you’re always just a click away from diving back into the action.

Key Features• Play Directly on Your Desktop: The action unfolds right on your desktop, overlaying seamlessly over anything you’re doing—perfect for multitasking!

• Cursor Combat: Your cursor becomes the hero, engaging in progressively fast-paced battles against waves of enemies.

• Dangerous Enemy Waves: Survive relentless hordes in a bullet hell experience that challenges your skills and reaction time.

• Variety of Weapons and Upgrades: Discover, acquire, and upgrade powerful items as you progress.

• Nostalgic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in retro-inspired visuals that capture the charm of classic PC gaming.

• Take a Break Anytime: Toggle the game on or off at any moment to pause, step away, and return whenever you’re ready.
description_short: Desktop Survivors 98 is a chaotic roguelite dungeon crawler that unfolds right on your Desktop. Your cursor becomes the hero as you explore new rooms, battle relentless waves of enemies, and collect powerful new weapons.
